events.title: Vagrant first released
events.summary: Mitchell Hashimoto released Vagrant 0.1.0 on March 7, 2010 — a tool for building reproducible development environments in virtual machines.
events.about: Vagrant reads a `Vagrantfile` describing a VM image, provisioning scripts, and port forwards — `vagrant up` boots an identical environment on any laptop. It standardized dev/prod parity before Docker dominated and led HashiCorp to Terraform and Consul. Example: a Rails app with Postgres running in VirtualBox after one command.

narrative.whyChosen: Vagrant made 'works on my machine' a solvable problem with shareable VM configs.
narrative.whyImportant: It popularized infrastructure-as-code for local development and spawned the HashiCorp ecosystem.
narrative.problemSolved: Onboarding to a project meant hours of manual dependency installation and broken environments.
